conventions.otsim_register: ot-sim literal register number; equals the PDU address (coil 1.., discrete 10001.., input 30001.., holding 40001..)
conventions.plc_iec: IEC 61131-3 located variable in the PLC
conventions.slave_pdu_address: OpenPLC v4 modbus_slave PDU address (0-based); holding registers are %QW, then %MW (at qw_count), then %MD, then %ML (see slave_layouts)
